_comment: VoiceGuard Processor - Pterodactyl Egg. Import in Panel > Nests > Import Egg.
name: VoiceGuard Processor
author: ati@palecrystal.eu
description: Python FastAPI + WebSocket processor for VoiceGuard Minecraft voice moderation. Uses faster-whisper for STT.
startup: if [ -d venv ]; then . venv/bin/activate; fi; python -m app.main

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl ffmpeg ca-certificates python3 python3-pip python3-venv >/dev/null

cd /mnt/server

# Redirect pip cache + tmp to /mnt/server (container /tmp is too small for PyTorch)
export TMPDIR=/mnt/server/.tmp
export PIP_CACHE_DIR=/mnt/server/.pip-cache
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR" "$PIP_CACHE_DIR"

# Pull source from your repo (set REPO_URL var in egg vars)
if [ -d /mnt/server/.vgsrc ]; then rm -rf /mnt/server/.vgsrc; fi
git clone --depth 1 "${REPO_URL}" /mnt/server/.vgsrc

# Copy only what we need
rm -rf app
cp -r /mnt/server/.vgsrc/app ./
cp /mnt/server/.vgsrc/requirements.txt ./
[ ! -f config.example.json ] && cp /mnt/server/.vgsrc/config.example.json ./ || true
rm -rf /mnt/server/.vgsrc

# Default config if missing
if [ ! -f config.json ]; then
  cp config.example.json config.json
  echo "[install] Created default config.json - edit it before starting!"
fi

# Python venv + deps. --no-cache-dir avoids keeping wheel files around.
python3 -m venv venv
. venv/bin/activate
pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip wheel
pip install --no-cache-dir --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu torch
pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# Clean up build artifacts to free disk space
rm -rf "$PIP_CACHE_DIR" "$TMPDIR"

mkdir -p models tmp logs

# Fix ownership so the runtime container can write to these directories
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server || true

echo "[install] Done."

variables.name: Repository URL
variables.description: Git URL to clone the processor source from on install/restart.
